description: Detailed AM and commercial intelligence case bank with realistic constraints and tradeoff-driven decisions.

cases.prompt: You are an Account Manager with only one weekly intervention slot. Decide whether SmartNest should get priority over other at-risk sellers, and justify using business impact, suspension risk, and salvageability. Output: ranked recommendation + rationale + 14-day plan.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Account health 72, ODR 3.08%, reserve hold 31%, Buy Box 33.4%.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two top ASINs show 18%+ returns and suppression history.
context_blocks.event_log: Final warning and disbursement hold in last 30 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Margin compressed to near break-even after chargebacks.

expected_good_response: Ranks intervention priority using explicit criteria.
Balances risk of suspension with potential recovery upside.
Includes tightly scoped 14-day action sequence with owners.
failure_traps: Recommends generic outreach without triage logic.
Ignores salvageability and time-to-impact tradeoff.

cases.prompt: Create a portfolio risk memo comparing CoastalCasa (ODR breach) and NorthPeak (suppression + returns risk). Recommend which seller gets AM escalation this week and why.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: CoastalCasa ODR above threshold; NorthPeak close to threshold with stronger topline.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Both have top ASIN volatility and Buy Box pressure.
context_blocks.event_log: Both sellers had high-severity events in last 21 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Coastal has heavier reserve hold pressure than NorthPeak.

expected_good_response: Compares urgency and intervention ROI, not just risk severity.
Uses account-health and revenue concentration together.
Produces clear recommendation with fallback action for non-priority seller.
failure_traps: Picks based on single metric only.
No contingency plan for second seller.

cases.prompt: NorthPeak lost Buy Box despite price cuts. Propose a strategy that restores Buy Box without violating minimum margin guardrail. Output: 3-step plan + price corridor + service metric targets.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Buy Box 62.3% with rising returns and claims.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Backpack ASIN margin 29.6%, active coupons compressing net contribution.
context_blocks.event_log: Chargeback cluster and suppression incidents in same period.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold now 18%.

expected_good_response: Separates price competitiveness from service-quality drivers.
Maintains explicit margin floor and guardrails.
Provides measurable targets for Buy Box-relevant metrics.
failure_traps: Recommends blanket price cuts below margin guardrail.
No mention of fulfillment/defect contribution to Buy Box.

cases.prompt: Air fryer ASIN has Buy Box decline and high promo dependency. Build a price/promo policy for next 6 weeks that protects margin while lifting conversion.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with fee leakage.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Air fryer with 17.3% margin and 12% promo discount currently active.
context_blocks.event_log: Post-promo claim volume elevated.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Chargebacks and fee disputes reducing contribution margin.

expected_good_response: Uses cadence-based promo policy instead of constant discounting.
Defines margin and conversion targets by week.
Includes stop-loss trigger if claims rise.
failure_traps: Assumes conversion gains always offset margin loss.
No risk controls tied to claims.

cases.prompt: HomeGrid is in hyper-growth with inbound delays. Design a replenishment strategy for next 8 weeks to avoid stockouts and aged inventory build. Include reorder points and inbound buffer logic.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: High-growth seller with 24% sessions QoQ growth.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two top ASINs with strong velocity and low return rates.
context_blocks.event_log: Port delay created temporary inbound disruption.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Healthy margin profile supports buffer inventory.

expected_good_response: Defines demand forecast bands and safety stock assumptions.
Balances stockout prevention against aged inventory cost.
Includes trigger thresholds for expedite vs normal replenishment.
failure_traps: Uses fixed reorder quantity with no demand variance handling.
Ignores inbound lead-time uncertainty.

cases.prompt: ToyNova has seasonal demand spikes and FC short receipts. Propose inventory policy that protects Q4 peak while limiting stranded and aged stock in Q1.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with seasonal concentration risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: STEM toy ASIN with high Q4 volatility.
context_blocks.event_log: Short-receipt and stranded inventory events in prior cycle.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Working capital sensitive to inventory lockups.

expected_good_response: Segments policy by season and FC reliability risk.
Includes receipt-variance adjustment in reorder logic.
Defines aged-inventory exit plan post-peak.
failure_traps: Applies uniform policy across peak and non-peak periods.
No mitigation for FC short-receipt risk.

cases.prompt: Build a margin bridge for VoltEdge: starting from gross GMV, quantify likely leakage from promotions, returns, chargebacks, reserve holds, and fee disputes. Recommend top 3 levers with estimated recovery impact.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with severe claims and suppression.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Electronics ASINs with high return and promo intensity.
context_blocks.event_log: Counterfeit complaint and deactivation warning recently issued.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Gross margin <17%, reserve hold 27%, chargebacks 24.

expected_good_response: Produces structured bridge with explicit leakage buckets.
Prioritizes interventions by impact and feasibility.
Connects commercial fixes to policy-risk reduction.
failure_traps: Only discusses topline GMV without contribution leakage.
No quantified prioritization.

cases.prompt: KitchenForge reports flat GMV but profit decline. Draft a margin diagnostic focused on fee reclassification, return-rate inflation, and promo overuse.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling account with recurring fee disputes.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Appliance ASINs have elevated return rates and promo costs.
context_blocks.event_log: Fee reclassification disputes active in last 30 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Gross margin 22.4% but net outcome deteriorating.

expected_good_response: Separates structural vs temporary margin headwinds.
Suggests data validation path for disputed fees.
Includes practical margin-recovery playbook.
failure_traps: Equates revenue stability with healthy profitability.
No sequencing of quick wins vs structural fixes.

cases.prompt: Hydration SKU promotions increased units but worsened returns and Buy Box. Diagnose promo ROI quality and propose a guardrailed deal strategy.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk seller with claims pressure.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Deal-heavy hydration ASIN with suppression and returns issues.
context_blocks.event_log: Promotion overlap with suppression event.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Margin compression plus chargeback uptick.

expected_good_response: Evaluates incremental profitable units, not gross units only.
Adds guardrails for return-rate and claim thresholds.
Recommends promo cadence aligned with inventory health.
failure_traps: Treats all promo lift as positive.
No linkage between promo cohort quality and returns.

cases.prompt: PeakStride wants to run aggressive promo calendar after viral growth spike. Build a plan to avoid margin erosion and stockouts while sustaining rank momentum.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: High-growth apparel seller with strong account health.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Leggings and tee SKUs with high conversion and tight inventory windows.
context_blocks.event_log: Viral demand spike in prior cycle.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Strong margin allows tactical, not blanket, discounting.

expected_good_response: Balances growth acceleration with inventory and margin controls.
Uses staged promo design with holdout periods.
Defines stockout risk triggers and stop conditions.
failure_traps: Pushes always-on discounts.
No inventory-aware promo pacing.

cases.prompt: Return rate is 19.2% on smart camera ASIN with complaints spanning defects, setup friction, and false expectations. Build a root-cause tree and top 5 fixes by expected defect reduction.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed seller, account health near deactivation risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Camera ASIN with low rating, high returns, and safety concerns.
context_blocks.event_log: A-to-Z and counterfeit complaints increased in same window.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Each point of return-rate reduction materially improves survival odds.

expected_good_response: Separates product defect, listing expectation, and fulfillment causes.
Prioritizes actions by expected impact and time-to-implement.
Includes instrumentation plan to verify causal improvement.
failure_traps: Single-cause diagnosis for multi-factor problem.
No measurement plan for fix validation.

cases.prompt: Air fryer return rate is above category norms. Create a focused diagnostic plan using customer reason codes and listing/content checks.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with claims and margin pressure.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Appliance SKU with elevated return and complaints.
context_blocks.event_log: Promotion periods overlap with return spikes.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Returns materially reducing net contribution.

expected_good_response: Defines reason-code segmentation and hypothesis tests.
Includes listing content and packaging quality checks.
Outputs prioritized remediation roadmap.
failure_traps: No use of reason-code segmentation.
Only advises customer service scripts without product/listing fixes.

cases.prompt: HomeGrid has high ROAS but wants to scale spend without efficiency collapse. Recommend budget reallocation rules and expansion criteria.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Healthy growth and strong conversion baseline.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core storage products with good inventory depth.
context_blocks.event_log: Recent inbound delays create supply constraints for one SKU.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Healthy margin supports controlled expansion.

expected_good_response: Uses guardrails for incremental spend by inventory and conversion health.
Defines criteria to graduate campaigns to scale tier.
Includes downside controls for ACOS drift.
failure_traps: Recommends linear budget increase with no checks.
Ignores inventory constraints in spend plan.

cases.prompt: VoltEdge is overspending on ads while conversion and rating decline. Build a survival-mode ad strategy that preserves discoverability but cuts waste.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with low Buy Box share and high returns.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Cable ASIN has high sessions but poor quality outcomes.
context_blocks.event_log: Suppression and authenticity events hurt conversion quality.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Cash constraints require rapid efficiency correction.

expected_good_response: Prioritizes branded and high-intent pockets; cuts wasteful broad spend.
Ties bid strategy to listing readiness and buy-box stability.
Defines minimum viable visibility thresholds.
failure_traps: Turns off all ads without recovery bridge.
No tie between ad strategy and listing quality constraints.

cases.prompt: Design a catalog quality sprint for NorthPeak to address title/variation defects and reduce suppression risk in 30 days.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk seller with suppression and return issues.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Hydration ASIN is suppressed for variation title mismatch.
context_blocks.event_log: Multiple listing quality incidents in quarter.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Suppression materially impacts promo ROI and cash flow.

expected_good_response: Creates weekly sprint plan with QA checkpoints.
Includes owner model for content, compliance, and operations.
Defines defect-rate KPIs to track improvement.
failure_traps: No owner/timeline assignment.
Treats catalog cleanup as one-time action only.

cases.prompt: Build a 45-day catalog remediation program for VoltEdge across safety docs, authenticity evidence, and listing quality to prevent deactivation.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed seller with suppression and authenticity risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core electronics ASINs under hazmat/authenticity pressure.
context_blocks.event_log: Deactivation warning and counterfeit complaint active.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High concentration risk on problematic ASINs.

expected_good_response: Phases workstream by compliance criticality and due dates.
Includes document governance and evidence repository standards.
Links remediation milestones to account-health risk reduction.
failure_traps: Focuses only on copy edits, ignoring compliance artifacts.
No milestone governance mechanism.

cases.prompt: CoastalCasa is facing reserve holds, high returns, and stuck inventory. Create a 60-day working-capital stabilization plan with cash preservation levers and risk controls.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk account with ODR breach and payout constraints.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Large-item decor SKUs with return and delivery issues.
context_blocks.event_log: Payout hold and ODR threshold breach recent.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Reserve hold 22%, reimbursements pending >11K.

expected_good_response: Prioritizes liquidity-preserving actions with impact/risk tradeoffs.
Includes inventory liquidation and procurement controls.
Connects operational quality fixes to cash-flow recovery.
failure_traps: Pure finance advice without operational levers.
No short-term vs medium-term split.

cases.prompt: ToyNova has cash tied in aged and stranded Q4 inventory. Recommend recovery actions to improve working capital before next buying cycle.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Seasonal seller with post-peak inventory drag.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: STEM toy SKU has elevated aged inventory and FC variance.
context_blocks.event_log: Stranded inventory spike in February.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Pending reimbursements and fee leakage reduce cash flexibility.

expected_good_response: Builds aging-bucket liquidation + relisting strategy.
Sets procurement constraints tied to sell-through recovery.
Tracks cash unlock metrics by week.
failure_traps: No quantifiable cash unlock plan.
Ignores next-cycle procurement implications.

cases.prompt: Seller signaled they may shift volume off-platform due to perceived algorithm unfairness. Build a retention strategy combining data transparency, quick wins, and trust restoration.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk seller with ODR and payout pressure.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core decor ASIN seeing Buy Box and rating pressure.
context_blocks.event_log: Escalation from seller management after ODR breach.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High reserve hold worsens seller sentiment.

expected_good_response: Addresses sentiment and economics, not just policy explanation.
Proposes immediate wins plus medium-term confidence plan.
Defines success signals for churn-risk reduction.
failure_traps: Dismisses seller concerns as purely emotional.
No measurable retention milestones.

cases.prompt: NorthPeak remains commercially strong but confidence is declining due to suppression and chargeback friction. Create a 30-day trust-rebuild AM plan.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: At-risk but recoverable seller with meaningful GMV base.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core SKUs still have demand but operational instability.
context_blocks.event_log: Recent suppression + reserve-hold increase.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Cash flow stress but not yet critical.

expected_good_response: Combines operational fixes with proactive communication rhythm.
Defines weekly milestones visible to seller leadership.
Includes escalation path if metrics worsen.
failure_traps: High-level relationship advice without metric-backed actions.
No contingency plan for continued deterioration.

cases.prompt: Draft QBR storyline for UrbanOffice: what improved, what deteriorated, and 3 commitments for next quarter with measurable outcomes.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Healthy account with moderate fee and fulfillment variance.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Desk/chair portfolio with solid Buy Box and stable demand.
context_blocks.event_log: Oversize fee adjustment impacted one SKU.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Margins stable but sensitive to fee reclassifications.

expected_good_response: Uses balanced narrative with evidence and clear priorities.
Defines commitments with owners and target metrics.
Separates operational hygiene from growth bets.
failure_traps: Purely celebratory narrative with no risks.
Commitments without measurable success criteria.

cases.prompt: Prepare a difficult QBR narrative for KitchenForge where GMV is flat but account quality and margins are eroding. Include how AM should frame urgency without triggering defensiveness.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Stalling seller with structural pressure signs.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core appliance SKUs showing return and fee stress.
context_blocks.event_log: Category fee reclassification dispute unresolved.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Profitability trend negative despite stable topline.

expected_good_response: Frames tension clearly: stable revenue vs declining quality economics.
Prioritizes 3 high-impact corrective commitments.
Uses communication framing to maintain seller engagement.
failure_traps: Blunt risk framing without relationship strategy.
No operational detail behind commitments.

cases.prompt: Run three what-if scenarios for VoltEdge: (A) no action, (B) compliance-first remediation, (C) portfolio pruning to top safe ASINs. Compare likely impact on account health, cash flow, and GMV over 60 days.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Distressed account with severe policy and performance risk.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two problematic but high-volume ASINs drive most revenue.
context_blocks.event_log: Active warnings and unresolved authenticity concerns.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: High reserve hold and chargeback pressure constrain options.

expected_good_response: Builds scenario comparison with explicit assumptions and risk levels.
Identifies dominant strategy under survival constraints.
Provides decision criteria and trigger points for pivot.
failure_traps: Presents one scenario without alternatives.
No assumptions transparency.

cases.prompt: Evaluate two expansion options for HomeGrid: launch 4 new ASINs now vs defer launch until inbound reliability improves. Include demand upside, stockout risk, and operational complexity.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: High-growth seller with strong baseline metrics.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Core ASIN inventory healthy but lead-time volatility present.
context_blocks.event_log: Recent port delay disrupted one inbound cycle.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Capital available for expansion but reputation risk if launch fails.

expected_good_response: Compares upside and operational risk using clear assumptions.
Recommends phased rollout with gate criteria.
Includes fallback if lead times worsen.
failure_traps: Binary recommendation without phased option.
No risk mitigation for inbound volatility.
